errors.evidence: Description states the range is 0,000 to 140,000, however, the y-axis shows up to 140,000 with an incorrect interpretation of the lower limit; it should start from 0.
The description does not specify any details about the y-axis units (percentage), which is critical given the context.
The description omits details about the grouping of bars by year, such as the proximity and arrangement, which affects understanding of the graph.
